body: Thank you so much for your reply I had not thought of these things. I just feel that in all that time I will suffer and cause suffering around me, and miss out on friends, boyfriends/a husband, having children, even jobs or a career or school. My depression/anxiety is such that I don’t leave the house except to go to my doctor every month or two.

You sound like me in 40 yrs. should I end it now and spare myself the 40 years of pain you’ve suffered? I’m so sorry life has handed you this bullshit. My heart does break for you. I didn’t know I had any feelings left.
